title: Intro Angle Picks

heading: Two new angles on Maddie rolling down the street
intro: Your note of 4 Nov: beat 0 is one view from in front for 86 s, so cut between three angles at sentence ends. Stills only, no video credit spent. Pick one side shot and one overhead shot (or note what to change). Then I animate the picks and cut them in. Left out: 2a (a stray: it came back from the first prompt) and 3a (shop signs with real brand names on them).
